title: Bodybuilding cuisine: Dummy proof vegetable medley recipe
summary: NH shares an easy oven-roasted vegetable medley (sweet onions, bell peppers, carrots) with olive oil, salt, soy sauce, garlic powder and a little ginger, roasted slowly around 400°F, then left in the cooling oven. It keeps 10-15 days and makes daily rice or pasta easy to eat.
claims: Base the medley on 3-5 sweet onions plus bell peppers; carrots and cabbage also work
Add spinach or cabbage only about 20 minutes before the end so they don't burn
Make a big batch since it shrinks a lot: 5-6 carrots, 4 bell peppers, 5 sweet onions
Coat generously with olive oil and salt well; add soy sauce, garlic powder and only a little ginger
Roast around 400°F for 1-1.5 hours, stirring at about the hour mark, then leave in the switched-off oven 30-45 minutes to reabsorb juices
Keep the leftover broth as a sauce for rice; it makes eating rice every day easy
The batch costs about $3-4 and keeps 10-15 days in the fridge
